$comment: Translations of the standard (i18n/standard.<locale>.json) that are to be checked again because the English changed after they were made: by locale, each English text as it is now, the key its translation is under, with the English the translation was made from. A translation listed here still shows until it is updated; once it is, remove its entry. npm run translations:review lists them, and a test fails on an entry whose English is unchanged or that no translation has. See README, Languages.
